title: Don't Let Them Out
deck: From thumbnail sketches to a poster on a tee.
client: “Don't Let Them Out,” directed by Lila McLaughlin
lede: For Lila McLaughlin's short film, the poster went from a page of thumbnail sketches to two finals, then off the screen and onto paper and tees.
challenge: The short film “Don't Let Them Out,” directed by Lila McLaughlin, needed original poster design and illustration: one image that holds the film's tension at the size of a one-sheet and of a thumbnail.
work: It started small: a page of thumbnail sketches, then process scans that narrowed the idea to two final posters.
The poster then left the screen. It was printed and shown leaning on a wall beside a smaller print, laid on a wood floor, and pinned above black and white tees printed with the same art.
credits: Dalton Corr: poster design and illustration
